BELIEVE IN — TOPIC SYNTHESIS AND PRACTICE
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what believe in — topic synthesis and practice means in plain words.
• Give one Kenyan example linked to Believe in.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Watch closely at a duka counter in Mombasa. On “Believe in — Topic Synthesis and Practice”, learners often mix up believe in with a nearby idea. Keep this accurate line instead: explain believe in with a clear local example and the correct terms. Supporting detail: 2.1 Believe in the By the end of the sub-strand .

MAIN NOTES
----
• 2.1 Believe in the By the end of the sub-strand .
• Learners are guided on the names of the Last 1.
• Belief that Allah knows all things.
• 2.0 PILLARS OF Day by abiding to the.
• Belief that Allah has written everything in.
• IMAN teachings of Islam Lauhul Mahfudh.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked situation at a school compound in Machakos: a learner investigates believe in — topic synthesis and practice within Believe in.
First, state the idea clearly: 2.1 Believe in the By the end of the sub-strand .
Next, apply it to one object or action at a school compound in Machakos and name what changes or what stays the same.
Finally, write one accurate conclusion sentence a teacher could tick — using the correct subject words for ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

IN EVERYDAY LIFE
----
At a school compound in Machakos, practise believe in — topic synthesis and practice during ordinary routines at home or school. Ask: what did I observe, which word or formula fits, and how do I check I am right? Use the diagram or working on this page as your model. Safety and respect come first.

SUMMARY
----
• 2.1 Believe in the By the end of the sub-strand .
• Learners are guided on the names of the Last 1.
• Belief that Allah knows all things.
• 2.0 PILLARS OF Day by abiding to the.

REVISION QUESTIONS
----
1. Define believe in — topic synthesis and practice in your own words and give one clear example.
2. Describe a situation at a school compound in Machakos that shows Believe in, using ideas from this page.
3. A learner makes a mistake about believe in — topic synthesis and practice. State the wrong idea, correct it, and justify your correction.

ANSWERS
----
1. 2.1 Believe in the By the end of the sub-strand . Example: connect it to something real at home, school, market, or a school compound in Machakos.
2. At a school compound in Machakos, observe carefully, name the correct idea from Believe in, and explain with one subject fact from the main notes.
3. Wrong idea: mixing believe in — topic synthesis and practice with a neighbouring concept or skipping the method. Correct idea: Topic synthesis and practice for Believe in in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. Justification: follow the worked example (and diagram if shown) on this page.
